topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen recognition and pattern recognition receptor signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects microbial and cellular damage signals through pattern recognition receptors and triggers downstream transcriptional pathways.

topics.label: Cellular activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells orchestrate leukocyte recruitment to tissues and coordinate both lymphatic trafficking and systemic inflammatory effects.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms responsible for turning off inflammation, healing damaged tissues, and managing persistent inflammatory states.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic.
